name: Hip bone
features: Ilium, ischium and pubis fused at the acetabulum
Iliac crest, anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS)
clinical: The ASIS is a key landmark for measuring leg length and locating the inguinal ligament.
sexDifferences: Female pelvis: wider and shallower, with a round or oval inlet, a subpubic angle of about 80–90° (about 50–60° in males), a wider greater sciatic notch, everted ischial tuberosities and a more triangular obturator foramen. These adapt it for childbirth.
